opt:body.p: A single measurement, data-forward: big value, small label, optional unit and status colour. Several sit side by side and wrap with the line.

The status colour is a projection of meaning. Put a term inside the KPI and it takes the term's severity: an outcome of pass shows as ok, fail as danger, skipped as neutral. The state attribute remains for values that are not terms.
opt:body.pre: <opt:kpi label="CPU temp" value="52" unit="°C" state="ok"></opt:kpi> <opt:kpi label="checks pass" value="23 of 23"> <opt:term scheme="outcome" value="pass"></opt:term> </opt:kpi>
